name: Beastmaster
theme: Apotheosis of the Pack. Two-on-one against every encounter — your beast hunts alongside, inherits your procs, marks alongside.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Summon a permanent animal companion (pick wolf / hawk / panther) that inherits your on-hit procs.'
Pairs with hunter.json beastmaster path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Pack Leader + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~22 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Pack Tempo.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 5 of 8 wireable today — companion-stat foundations (Pack Bond / Companion's Vigor) are decorative until Phase F lands the companion mechanic; player-side stat-sticks and Mark conditionals work. Pack Leader capstone (permanent companion + full proc inheritance) needs Phase F.

nodes.name: Bond of the Wild
nodes.description: +1/2/3% crit chance (foundation — your shots and your beast's bites both crit harder).

nodes.name: Pack Tempo
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% attack speed (foundation tempo for hand-off rotations).

nodes.name: Wild Mark
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply Mark (cross-skill Mark applier — preserves Mark engine even mid-companion-rotation).

nodes.name: Pack Awareness
nodes.description: +5% damage (1-rank identity — foundation amplifier representing the always-on companion presence).

nodes.name: Bond of Hunting
nodes.description: +5/10/15% damage to Marked targets (Marked-vulnerability scaler — your hits + companion's hits both benefit).

nodes.name: Pack Leader
nodes.description: Summon a permanent animal companion (pick wolf / hawk / panther at ascendancy time). It inherits your on-hit procs and Mark application in full. The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
